question:
Choose the correct meaning of the idiom:

Earned his accolades
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. "Gained recognition or honor." [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Earned his accolades"** means achieving recognition or honor for one's accomplishments or hard work. (सम्मान अर्जित करना) • **Example:** After years of dedication to his craft, the artist finally earned his accolades from critics and audiences alike. • **Accolades** refers to expressions of praise or awards given as acknowledgment for someone's achievements. (प्रशंसा या पुरस्कार) • **Example:** She received accolades from her peers for her groundbreaking research. • Hence, the correct meaning of the idiom is "Gained recognition or honor." Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 2: Lost all respect** (सम्मान खोना): Refers to a situation where someone loses their reputation or standing. • **Example:** After the scandal, he lost all respect in the eyes of his colleagues. • **Option 3: Altered his stance** (अपना दृष्टिकोण बदल लिया): Means changing one's opinion or position on a particular matter. • **Example:** He altered his stance on the issue after hearing the opposing arguments. • **Option 4: Accumulated wealth** (धन एकत्रित करना): Refers to the act of gathering or amassing riches or assets. • **Example:** Over the years, he accumulated wealth through wise investments. 37:T679, The correct answer is **option 1.**
